scope: Explicit foreign clipboard integration through compiled managed local/shared original/document SDKs and all four actual React wrappers, paired application Wasm and offline-installed candidate archives. DOM, clipboard stores, IndexedDB and Web Locks are synthetic fixtures.

contracts.lowLevelOptIn: Complete structural adapter object with matching native clipboard admission
contracts.managedOptIn: Factory bound to the actual native owner before mounting; configuration only
contracts.reactFactory: Immutable per sessionKey; onInterchange callback remains live
contracts.publication: One existing guarded native edit; revision captured before converter callbacks and retained through the bounded queue
contracts.reports: Frozen source format notices and optional native destination projection, after retained Copy or accepted Cut/Paste only
contracts.captionAndCodeFlowPaste: Insert native-projected text and report formatting loss, not sibling rich blocks
contracts.images: Explicit synchronous registry mapping to host-owned immutable bytes; no importer fetch or automatic companion-file ownership

defaultSharedDocumentDom.inputClock: Controlled monotonic fixture, including 1 ms and 751 ms gaps; not wall-clock performance qualification

retainedNonpassingAttempt.probe: Earlier shared document DOM regression with uncontrolled input clock during concurrent heavy probes
retainedNonpassingAttempt.result: Natural typing expected one Undo entry and observed two
retainedNonpassingAttempt.cause: Original input timestamps were not captured, so the exact cause of that run is not established
retainedNonpassingAttempt.testChange: The semantic probe now controls its monotonic input clock and separately proves joining at 1 ms and splitting at 751 ms in mixed and hidden-only documents

repairedDuringImplementation: Loss notifications now travel with queued native work rather than announcing success immediately after preparation
Converter callbacks cannot retarget Cut/Paste to a newer native selection or publication
Opted-in Cut refuses deletion when any private/plain/HTML/Markdown item is missing or changed
Node 22 jsdom/parser ESM loading order is explicit in the probe, not a product import workaround
Installed fixture uses the cached repository jsdom transport version and canonical macOS temporary paths; product dependencies were not changed
remaining: Combined clean-installed mixed-content editing, offline/concurrent transport and asset workflow acceptance for the unchanged overall goal
Real OS clipboard and captured Word/Google Docs/Excel application samples beyond representative markup fixtures
Deferred broad browser, historical WebKit, native IME/accessibility, performance and final release qualification
